notes: Real marketing-qualified leads and closed deals from Olist, a Brazilian marketplace, covering its acquisition of sellers as business clients. Joins to the Olist e-commerce dataset on seller id, which is what makes lead-to-revenue attribution possible rather than just lead counting.
gaps: Leads are marketing-qualified only; anything before qualification is absent.
Anonymised sales reps, so rep-level findings cannot be validated externally.
Brazilian marketplace, mid-2017 to end-2018 — not a legal-services market.
Declared monthly revenue is self-reported by the lead and is unverified.
